name: Karn
description: Karn is a sentient silver golem and planeswalker, created by Urza, who has near-complete mastery over artifacts and is known for creating Mirrodin and for his long fight against the Phyrexians.

summary.text: Karn is a sentient silver golem and planeswalker, created by Urza, who has near-complete mastery over artifacts and is known for creating Mirrodin and for his long fight against the Phyrexians.

bio.text: Karn shaped the plane of Mirrodin and left his creation Memnarch in charge of it, but something went wrong and he unwittingly introduced Phyrexian oil to the plane.
Losing his mind, he became the Father of Machines and leader of Phyrexia until Venser sacrificed his spark to restore him to sanity.
Returning to Dominaria, he dug up the Sylex with his automatons, promised Multani he would take it to New Phyrexia, and joined the fight against Bolas without taking the Gatewatch oath.
Later, in the Caves of Koilos, he found a Phyrexian staging ground, failed to destroy Sheoldred with an incendiary device, and was buried for months by Rona's cave-in.
Once freed, he gave false locations of the sylex to find a Phyrexian spy, and then baited the Phyrexians with the sylex, the Mana Rig and himself.
After Ajani crushed the sylex, a Planar Bridge carried Karn to New Phyrexia, where Elesh Norn welcomed him as Father, then held him captive and had him dismantled.
Found vivisected at the root chamber, he was freed by Melira and Koth, then gave up Venser's spark to help restore Nissa and Ajani.
He built himself a new body and killed Elesh Norn himself.

status.text: As of the latest story he is alive in a new body, helping build a new village in Zhalfir and holding a creature with the others while Nissa tries to summon an elemental.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Jhoira that Karn was rescued from the Phyrexians and has returned to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Were you aware the Planeswalker called Karn was found and rescued from the Phyrexians?

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals that Venser gave up his spark to save Karn and died.
timeline.quote: Venser gave up his spark to Karn, to rescue him. Venser did not survive.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds giant automatons digging a crater.
timeline.quote: They were each around twenty feet high, with scoops for hands and big blocky heads.

timeline.summary: Animated trees attack and tear apart an automaton.
timeline.quote: It leapt on the nearest automaton and ripped it apart.

timeline.summary: A small automaton warns Chandra that the trees attack any movement.
timeline.quote: Take care. They will attack any movement.

timeline.summary: The automaton says Multani animated the trees.
timeline.quote: They're animated trees, created and sent by Multani.

timeline.summary: Karn explains Multani is injured and acts out of instinct.
timeline.quote: Multani is an elemental, and has been in a semiconscious state

timeline.summary: Karn reveals he is the friend who has been gone a long time.
timeline.quote: I'm Karn. And I am someone who has been gone for a long time.

timeline.summary: The next morning Karn tells Chandra that the automatons are digging for the Sylex, which Urza created, and that he means to detonate it on New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: It was created by Urza to help defeat the Phyrexians. I intend to take it to New Phyrexia and detonate it there.

timeline.summary: Karn uncovers the Sylex beneath a broken slab in the pit.
timeline.quote: "He's found the Sylex." Jaya let her breath out, but she didn't look relieved.

timeline.summary: Animate trees swarm the crater to reach the Sylex, and Chandra and Jaya fight them off with fire.
timeline.quote: They were desperate to get to Karn and the Sylex.

timeline.summary: Multani rises as a giant of roots and branches, and Karn says he is still semiconscious.
timeline.quote: He's still semiconscious. He would never hurt us if he were himself.

timeline.summary: Karn promises Multani he will take the Sylex to New Phyrexia and never harm Dominaria.
timeline.quote: It will never harm Dominaria, I swear it.

timeline.summary: Teferi greets Karn aboard the Weatherlight, and Jhoira says Ajani told her of Venser's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Ajani Goldmane came to tell me. Teferi knows, too.

timeline.summary: Slimefoot climbs on deck, sees open water, and meets Karn, who tells it the ship is heading to Urborg to destroy Belzenlok in the Cabal's Stronghold.
timeline.quote: We are on our way to Urborg, to destroy the demon Belzenlok in the Stronghold of the Cabal.

timeline.summary: Karn apologizes for disturbing Yavimaya to retrieve the Sylex and says he means to end the Phyrexians forever.
timeline.quote: I mean to end them forever.

timeline.summary: At dawn the party sees the Stronghold in the volcano's caldera, and Gideon, Chandra, Karn and Teferi set out on foot.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok has done some rebuilding,

timeline.summary: Teferi slows time around a grotto of spirits so the party can pass unseen.
timeline.quote: With a gesture Teferi slowed time around the spirits

timeline.summary: Teferi reveals he fought Bolas long ago and lost, and says he took his spark back to join the fight; Karn says he will consider the invitation.
timeline.quote: One of the reasons I took my spark back was to come with you.

timeline.summary: Karn says he will consider joining the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: I'll consider your invitation.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Karn rejoin the ship as the Weatherlight attacks, and Teferi dissolves the first gate while Jhoira's owl blows up the next with a mana-burner.
timeline.quote: Teferi held out his hand and the gate across the causeway turned red with corrosion, then dissolved in a puff of rust.

timeline.summary: Urgoros lands on the deck and fights the crew, and Liliana cannot control it or use the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Jhoira, I can't stop it!

timeline.summary: Tiana deflects Urgoros's spear to save Liliana, and Jaya, Karn, Tiana and Arvad drive it off the ship.
timeline.quote: Tiana suddenly landed in front of her.

timeline.summary: Gideon gives Teferi the Gatewatch oath, while Karn and Jaya agree to fight Bolas without taking the oath.
timeline.quote: Gideon was giving Teferi the Gatewatch oath while Chandra stood by.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers leave Dominaria, but Liliana cannot planeswalk and Nicol Bolas appears to claim her.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas materialized out of the darkness, his huge scaled dragon form looming over her

timeline.summary: On the new plane Jace tells the others that Liliana never intended to come and used them, but Gideon insists she has changed.
timeline.quote: She used you, just like she uses everyone.

timeline.summary: Jace, Lavinia, Gideon, Teferi, Chandra, Jaya, Ajani and Karn arrive and join the fight, and Gideon names the enemy the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Form up! The Eternals are still coming! We need to save as many people as possible!

timeline.summary: Guild forces and planeswalkers charge the Citadel as the Dreadhorde engages them.
timeline.quote: Those Planeswalkers not fallen—or not yet fallen—were side by side with guild warriors, engaging the silent Dreadhorde.

timeline.summary: Planeswalkers debate what to do with the Immortal Sun, and Ajani insists the Gatewatch renew its purpose.
timeline.quote: we need to confirm that the next time a threat rises, the Gatewatch will be there

timeline.summary: Karn repairs a broken excavator in the Caves of Koilos and recalls Jhoira doubting that the Phyrexians are on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Karn placed his hand on the excavator.

timeline.summary: The excavator opens a sealed Thran workshop, and Karn finds a diagram of the sylex and a clay tablet with matching symbols.
timeline.quote: a diagram of the sylex painted on parchment

timeline.summary: Karn returns to camp, where Jhoira's unanswered letters lie, and examines the sylex, which shocks him.
timeline.quote: The sylex sent a jolt through him.

timeline.summary: Karn recalls Urza teaching him about pain and the loss of Mirrodin, which he believes was his fault.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians had taken it from him.

timeline.summary: Digging near the workshop, Karn finds living Phyrexian cables embedded in the rock and tears one free, causing a cave-in that destroys the workshop and blocks his way back.
timeline.quote: The other cables contracted within the wall—and the ceiling to the ancient workshop thundered to the ground.

timeline.summary: Karn follows the Phyrexian tunnel and defeats two Society of Mishra acolytes, who warn him that Sheoldred welcomes him and that others are coming.
timeline.quote: Sheoldred welcomes you!

timeline.summary: Karn finds the Phyrexian staging ground, where acolytes compleat humans and Sheoldred hangs suspended.
timeline.quote: He'd found the staging ground of the Phyrexian invasion.

timeline.summary: An acolyte raises an alarm, the Phyrexians begin evacuating, and Rona attacks Karn with a glaive.
timeline.quote: The shrill sound prompted action.

timeline.summary: Karn fights through Sheoldred's worshippers on a bridge and reaches the praetor.
timeline.quote: Karn pushed himself to his feet and charged down the narrow stone bridge.

timeline.summary: Karn defeats Rona, breaking her mechanical eye, but refuses to kill her, saying he is not a weapon.
timeline.quote: "I am not a weapon."

timeline.summary: When Karn touches Sheoldred, she whispers to him and he learns Phyrexian sleeper agents are hidden in every land of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Phyrexian sleeper agents lurked in every land in Dominaria

timeline.summary: As Karn plants an incendiary device inside Sheoldred, Rona's magic paralyzes him.
timeline.quote: But his hand did not move.

timeline.summary: Rona tells Karn the forces have evacuated to secondary staging areas, and Sheoldred splits into spider-like pieces that scatter over him.
timeline.quote: Sheoldred split apart, dividing herself up in pieces.

timeline.summary: Rona taunts Karn about Memnarch and collapses the cavern onto him.
timeline.quote: Tons of rock poured onto him.

timeline.summary: Buried, Karn cannot planeswalk because of interference and is trapped, the only one who knows Sheoldred is on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: He was trapped.

timeline.summary: Ajani digs Karn out of the cave-in, explaining Jhoira had a tracking spell on her letters, and tells Karn he has been buried for months.
timeline.quote: She asked Raff to place a tracking spell on the letters

timeline.summary: Karn and Ajani return to Karn's camp, and Karn tells Ajani what he saw of Sheoldred.
timeline.quote: Karn set the box aside. He faced Ajani and related all he had seen.

timeline.summary: Ajani proposes speaking to the leaders at the Keldon-Benalish peace summit, and the two planeswalk to Oyster Bay.
timeline.quote: there is a peace summit between the Keldons and the Benalish.

timeline.summary: Karn and Ajani warn Jodah, Jaya and the summit leaders that the Phyrexians have returned, but are met with doubt.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians have returned to Dominaria.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya refuse to halt negotiations without a location for the Phyrexians but promise to help afterward.
timeline.quote: "We will go with you, Karn," said Jaya.

timeline.summary: Karn builds a scrying device and finds he cannot scry Sheoldred; Ajani gives him a copy of the amulet to summon the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: They must have protections in place to prevent us from scrying them.

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Karn and Ajani that the Phyrexians have taken Tamiyo.
timeline.quote: "but they took Tamiyo.

timeline.summary: Karn secretly moves the sylex from his room to Jhoira's workshop on the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: He stowed the sylex and its case on the lowest shelf behind lengths of pipe

timeline.summary: Stenn meets Karn on a hill, telling him King Darien tasked him with finding Phyrexian agents and that New Argive will mobilize.
timeline.quote: New Argive will mobilize.

timeline.summary: Karn seizes a thrush that is a Phyrexian spy, which attacks him with corrosive cables, and the group traps it in a cage.
timeline.quote: Karn seized the bird. "I know what you are."

timeline.summary: Karn presents the caged Phyrexian bird to the negotiators; three Benalish knights burst open into Phyrexian monsters and break the table.
timeline.quote: Three of the Benalish knights exploded outward from their armor.

timeline.summary: Radha and the Keldons withdraw and lock the Phyrexians into the room with the planeswalkers, who fight them.
timeline.quote: The brass double doors slammed shut

timeline.summary: Jodah opens a portal to New Argive's watchtower; Karn, Teferi, Stenn and Jodah escape while Jaya burns the room.
timeline.quote: Jaya grinned in triumph as she raised her hands in a blaze of fire and set the whole room alight.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian creature follows through the portal; Stenn locks down the watchtower and gives Karn the key, as they realize they cannot trust anyone.
timeline.quote: Stenn handed Karn the key.

timeline.summary: Locked in the watchtower, Karn refuses to reveal the sylex's location or his plan until the group captures the Phyrexian spy and is sure of its members.
timeline.quote: "I have a plan to find and defeat Sheoldred," Karn said.

timeline.summary: The group splits up to search the tower, Karn and Teferi taking the lower floors and Stenn the basement.
timeline.quote: "Jaya and I can take the upper floors," Jodah said.

timeline.summary: Karn and Teferi find signs of the creature in the storage room and overhear Jodah and Jaya arguing through a vent.
timeline.quote: A throbbing chunk of meat had attached itself, barnacle-like, to the copper.

timeline.summary: Teferi apologizes to Karn for how Urza treated him; Karn tells Teferi he hid the sylex in a sea cave by Tolaria West.
timeline.quote: I have hidden it in a sea cave by Tolaria West.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya fight the squid-like Phyrexian, which splits into pieces and escapes through the stone.
timeline.quote: The creature split again, this time into four small chittering beasts

timeline.summary: Jodah makes locators from samples of the Phyrexian flesh, and Karn watches Ajani in a scryer.
timeline.quote: Ajani seemed to be fighting.

timeline.summary: Karn tells Jodah the sylex is in a warehouse in Estark; the locators then point in every direction as creatures swarm Karn and Jodah.
timeline.quote: Creatures flung themselves at Karn and Jodah, cables outstretched and mouths seeking.

timeline.summary: Jaya saves Jodah and Karn with a blast of fire, which seems to sterilize the creatures.
timeline.quote: Flame roared throughout the room.

timeline.summary: Karn tells Jaya the sylex is hidden in Suq'Ata.
timeline.quote: "Yes," Karn said. "It is hidden in Suq'Ata."

timeline.summary: Karn and Jaya find Teferi pinned and gutted by a Phyrexian monstrosity; Karn kills it and Jaya burns dozens more.
timeline.quote: They found Teferi pinned to floor by a Phyrexian monstrosity

timeline.summary: The group goes to the powerstone chamber, where Karn tells Stenn the sylex is in the ruins of Trokair on Sarpadia.
timeline.quote: "I concealed it in the ruins of Trokair, on Sarpadia."

timeline.summary: Stenn is revealed as a Phyrexian sleeper agent who transforms himself into an antenna and transmits the false location to Sheoldred.
timeline.quote: He had converted his entire body into an antenna, Karn realized

timeline.summary: Stenn's cables ensnare Jaya, and Karn dismembers him as Jaya burns him; the tower's lockdown is lifted.
timeline.quote: He dismembered Stenn—no, not Stenn, the Phyrexian who had killed Stenn

timeline.summary: Karn calls the Weatherlight with the amulet and Shanna promises to come, while the group braces for the Phyrexians closing in.
timeline.quote: "You're in luck—we're not far.

timeline.summary: On the Weatherlight, Karn proposes forcing the Phyrexians into open war by baiting them with the sylex, the Mana Rig and himself; the group splits up to recruit allies.
timeline.quote: "We must force the Phyrexians into open warfare," Karn said

timeline.summary: Darigaaz destroys a Phyrexian monster attacking the Weatherlight over Shiv and accepts Teferi's proposal to fight.
timeline.quote: "I accept your proposal to fight here at Shiv.

timeline.summary: Karn and Jhoira reconcile in her workshop and she plans a self-destruct mechanism for the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: "Ah, I missed you." Jhoira laughed and embraced him.

timeline.summary: Jodah calls Karn to say Meria recruited neighboring groups and warns that there is a spy in the New Coalition.
timeline.quote: "There is a spy in the New Coalition."

timeline.summary: Teferi brings Karn a captured Phyrexian saboteur that was in the food stores; Karn burns it in a crucible.
timeline.quote: It's the second saboteur I've found.

timeline.summary: Teferi apologizes to Karn for treating him as a thing, and Karn accepts.
timeline.quote: For what it's worth, Karn, I apologize for how I treated you in the past.

timeline.summary: A klaxon sounds as a vast Phyrexian army rises from the desert and begins to climb the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: The first wave of Phyrexians scaled the Mana Rig's sides.

timeline.summary: Karn sees that the Weatherlight has been compleated and is dropping Phyrexian horrors onto the deck.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians had compleated the Weatherlight .

timeline.summary: Ertai, now a Phyrexian with doubled arms, leaps onto the Mana Rig and confronts Karn.
timeline.quote: It's been quite some time, old friend.

timeline.summary: Ertai's spell freezes Karn's joints, lifts him and begins to crush and pull him apart limb by limb.
timeline.quote: He was pulling Karn apart, limb by limb, like a cruel child torturing an insect.

timeline.summary: Believing he will die, Karn generates a titanium and carbon casing around the distant sylex to protect it.
timeline.quote: He spun the densest carbon filaments he could from the aether and encased the sylex in its lockbox in titanium.

timeline.summary: Ajani arrives on the Golden Argosy and knocks Ertai off the Mana Rig, freeing Karn.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian mage stumbled backwards, concentration broken—and with a scream, tumbled over the side of the Mana Rig.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred rises on a dragon-engine body and demands the sylex from Karn, showing his plan to draw her out had worked.
timeline.quote: You have the sylex for me.

timeline.summary: Compleated Ajani drives his axe into Jaya, and wounds Karn with it.
timeline.quote: He swept up his axe and drove into her body.

timeline.summary: Ajani crumples the sylex in his hand, destroying it.
timeline.quote: he lifted the sylex—and crumpled it in his hand, as if the ancient artifact were made of nothing more than paper.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred slams into the Mana Rig again, splits from her host body, reveals a stolen face and tells Karn the next step in evolution will be compleated.
timeline.quote: The next step in evolution will be compleated.

timeline.summary: Jodah portals Danitha, Radha, Meria and the troops to safety and steps through his final portal.
timeline.quote: Jodah pulled up a portal and threw Danitha, Radha, and Meria into it

timeline.summary: A scarlet Planar Bridge opens and carries Sheoldred, Ajani and Karn away from Dominaria.
timeline.quote: it . . . stole him away.

timeline.summary: Karn arrives in a Phyrexian cavern and is welcomed by Elesh Norn, who calls him Father.
timeline.quote: Welcome, Father.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn shows the helpless Karn a small oil-beaded sapling and calls it the beginning of everything.
timeline.quote: It is the beginning of great things, Father.

timeline.summary: Karn lies bound on a slab as Suture Bishops dissect him, offering no resistance, while Tezzeret watches.
timeline.quote: But Karn gave no resistance to the team of aspirants as they bound him into place

timeline.summary: Ajani, compleated, quotes Elesh Norn's scripture over Karn as the priests dismantle him.
timeline.quote: Only in her grace are we saved,

timeline.summary: Tezzeret feigns obedience and sets out through the Fair Basilica toward the core pushing Karn's pieces.
timeline.quote: As our Mother wishes,

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reaches Memnarch's restored darksteel Panopticon and cannot open its door.
timeline.quote: darksteel, as a matter of fact

timeline.summary: Karn speaks, explaining he is tethered to the plane and offering to open the tower, since it was once his realm.
timeline.quote: I can take you inside. This was my realm once, after all.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret detaches Karn's head and Karn uses it to open the darksteel door.
timeline.quote: Karn's efforts caused the door to slide open.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret and Karn argue over Karn's responsibility for New Phyrexia and Bolas's threat, and Tezzeret reveals he suggested eliminating the plane to Bolas.
timeline.quote: His first act as god-emperor would have been to obliterate New Phyrexia from existence.

timeline.summary: Karn admits he hears the same oil voices as Tezzeret, and Tezzeret threatens him but relents, fearing compleation.
timeline.quote: The same voices I heard when the oil had command of my heart.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reaches Elesh Norn at the heart of the plane, where she takes Karn's torso and welcomes him to the great work.
timeline.quote: We welcome you to our great work.

timeline.summary: Karn speaks of Jhoira and is cut off by Elesh Norn; Tezzeret sees it as a good move on his part.
timeline.quote: Jhoira . . . Jhoira is my friend . . . my best friend.

timeline.summary: The group finds Karn vivisected and bound at the center of the root chamber.
timeline.quote: The great silver golem had been broken open, vivisected, and spread across the platform.

timeline.summary: Karn tells them the invasion is still young and that they must detonate the sylex at the root source.
timeline.quote: You will need to get to the root source and detonate it.

timeline.summary: Koth and Melira stay behind to free Karn while Elspeth goes on, refusing to run any more.
timeline.quote: No more running.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn has Urabrask dismembered and Karn brought before her to witness her celebration over shackled Mirrans.
timeline.quote: With another snap she dismisses Urabrask—the centurions chop him into quarters and carry him off.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Karn recalls leaving word not to follow him when he first tried to solve Mirrodin's Phyrexian problem, and being saved by Venser's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: If it wasn't for Venser sacrificing his spark, Karn would be dead.

timeline.summary: Karn, lashed to slag held aloft by Norn's choir, is being taken apart as Norn taunts him.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians have been taking him apart, piece by piece, and repurposing his silver body.

timeline.summary: Norn calls Karn the False Patriarch and demands he answer Phyrexia; Jin-Gitaxias raises his claws to strike Karn.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias raises an arm to strike.

timeline.summary: Elspeth arrives as an angel in golden armor, blocking Jin-Gitaxias's strike and sending his legions into the abyss.
timeline.quote: An angel in gleaming armor, a golden blade now raised to counter Jin-Gitaxias's strike.

timeline.summary: Melira frees Karn's platform and Koth uses stone to bring Karn along with the fleeing group.
timeline.quote: Karn's slab flies out to meet them.

timeline.summary: Teferi visits the healer's ward and finds Karn, Koth, Chandra and Kaya arguing around comatose Nissa and Ajani and the dying Melira.
timeline.quote: The air in the room is taut as a bowstring when Teferi enters.

timeline.summary: Melira proposes a plan to heal Nissa and Ajani that will cost her life and Karn's spark.
timeline.quote: "I think I have an idea for fixing the two of them."

timeline.summary: Teferi stops time in a bubble so Melira and Karn can cleanse Nissa and Ajani.
timeline.quote: But here they have only the space between two beats of a drum to save their friends.

timeline.summary: Karn pulls out Nissa's and Ajani's sparks and gives up Venser's spark to filter them while Melira cleans them.
timeline.quote: "Together, Venser," he says

timeline.summary: Ajani wakes briefly and falls asleep; Melira dies, and Koth, Teferi and Karn comfort one another.
timeline.quote: "She's gone."

timeline.summary: Karn builds a new body and Norn crawls skinless toward the portal as her army tears her apart.
timeline.quote: Crawling toward them is a skinless abomination.

timeline.summary: Karn kills Elesh Norn himself and walks through the portal as Teferi resumes time.
timeline.quote: Karn lays a hand on what remains of Norn's head.

timeline.summary: Nissa digs a grave at night in Zhalfir, wondering whether she lost her spark; her friends say Teferi's and Koth's sparks have faded too.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: is this what happens when a Planeswalker loses her spark?

timeline.summary: Nissa tries to feel Zhalfir but the plane does not answer, and she feels cut off from the Multiverse as the others settle in the new village.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: But Zhalfir still never spoke to her.

timeline.summary: Nissa fails to summon an elemental and is thrown by the beast; Teferi freezes it and Karn holds it before it escapes.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: She sees Teferi, staff outstretched, his radiant, blue spell holding the beast in place.

timeline.summary: The group studies the portal; Nissa hears faint Zendikar in it and the others advise caution and a hunt for the creature first.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: it sounds like Zendikar.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight and its crew, with the Legacy including Karn, thwart Phyrexia's near invasion of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia nearly invaded Dominaria, were it not for the skyship Weatherlight and its crew.

timeline.summary: Karn, after finding friends, saving the Multiverse and becoming a planeswalker, sets off to create his own legacy.
timeline.quote: After finding true friends, saving the Multiverse, and becoming a Planeswalker, Karn set off to create his own legacy.

timeline.summary: Karn's created world is twisted by the influence of Phyrexia through his own accidental actions.
timeline.quote: that world became twisted by the influence of Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Karn is determined to stop at nothing until the Phyrexians are destroyed.
timeline.quote: Karn will stop at nothing until they are destroyed.

timeline.summary: Karn creates Mirrodin, but something goes wrong and he unwittingly introduces Phyrexian oil.
timeline.quote: He unwittingly introduced a dark contagion: Phyrexian oil.

timeline.summary: The Warden Karn created grows unstable and sentient, calling himself Memnarch.
timeline.quote: Even the Warden that Karn created to protect the plane grew unstable, gaining sentience and calling himself Memnarch.

timeline.summary: Karn brings the Phyrexian oil to Mirrodin, which begins transforming the creatures it touches.
timeline.quote: Karn was the bringer of the Phyrexian oil to Mirrodin

timeline.summary: Losing his mind, Karn becomes the Father of Machines and leader of Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Slowly losing his mind, Karn became the Father of Machines and the leader of Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Koth, Elspeth and Venser cannot turn the tide, and Venser sacrifices his life to restore Karn to sanity.
timeline.quote: Venser sacrificed his life to restore Karn to sanity.

relations.note: Venser gave up his spark to rescue Karn and died.
relations.quote: Venser gave up his spark to Karn, to rescue him. Venser did not survive.

relations.note: Karn was her friend.
relations.quote: Karn was her friend too, and their grief for Venser was shared.

relations.note: The trees attack Karn and his automatons.
relations.quote: It leapt on the nearest automaton and ripped it apart.

relations.note: Urza created the Sylex, not Karn; Karn intends to use it
relations.quote: It was created by Urza to help defeat the Phyrexians.

relations.note: Jaya came to help protect the excavation from Multani
relations.quote: Yes, to help protect the excavation from Multani's attacks.

relations.note: Karn wants to destroy them forever with the Sylex
relations.quote: I need to take it to New Phyrexia and destroy their plane once and for all.

relations.note: Venser was Karn's friend
relations.quote: He was a good friend.

relations.note: they part as friends
relations.quote: She turned to Karn, and hugged him too, despite the hard edges of his metal body.

relations.note: Karn is Urza's creation.
relations.quote: "I may not be able to stop you, Urza's creation,"

relations.note: Karn created Memnarch and gave him intelligence.
relations.quote: "You gave Memnarch your intelligence.

relations.note: Jhoira writes to Karn, begging him to come back.
relations.quote: Please come back.

relations.note: Karn tries to destroy Sheoldred with an incendiary device.
relations.quote: Karn reached between the plates on her thorax and deposited the incendiary device inside her body.

relations.note: They fight and she buries him.
relations.quote: "Your mistake," she said, "was not killing me when you had the chance.

relations.note: Karn thinks of Urza as designing him.
relations.quote: Karn had never been permitted to "recuperate" when Urza had loosed him as a war machine.

relations.note: Ajani rescues Karn and backs his warning.

pages_say.description: A former companion Jhoira misses.
A planeswalker friend of Jhoira's who was rescued from the Phyrexians and has returned to Dominaria.
A metal being with a human-like face who has been gone a long time and fights Multani's animated trees.
A metal planeswalker who digs up the Sylex with his automatons, intending to detonate it on New Phyrexia.
A metal being returning to the Weatherlight who plans to take the Sylex to New Phyrexia and destroy that plane.
A metal being who guides the infiltration party and says he will consider joining the fight against Bolas.
A metal being who fights Urgoros and agrees to join the fight against Bolas without taking the oath.
A silver, sentient automaton who arrives with the fighters.
A planeswalker who helped shut down the Planar Bridge.
A silver golem planeswalker who crushes Eternals.
A member of the Gatewatch who investigates the Phyrexian threat.
A figure Elspeth thinks of in the context of New Phyrexia.
A silver golem planeswalker created by Urza who searches the Caves of Koilos for the secret of the sylex and discovers a Phyrexian staging ground on Dominaria.
A silver golem planeswalker, immune to Phyrexian influence, who has been buried for months and now tries to warn Dominaria about Sheoldred.
A silver golem planeswalker immune to Phyrexian influence who gives each companion a false location for the sylex to find a spy.
A silver golem planeswalker who proposes baiting the Phyrexians with the sylex, the Mana Rig and himself, and works at the Mana Rig with Jhoira.
A silver golem planeswalker and Coalition member who can generate material from the Blind Eternities; he is captured by the Phyrexians and brought before Elesh Norn.
A golem planeswalker taken by the Phyrexians.
The golem that contains everything the real Xantcha was.
The silver golem planeswalker, held captive and dismantled by Phyrexian priests, who still keeps his mind.
The silver golem who promised the spirits to take the sylex away.
The silver golem planeswalker, gone, who believed his sylex was the real one.
A member of the Gatewatch whose call brought the strike team to New Phyrexia.
A planeswalker whose plan the strike team follows; he has not been seen since arrival.
A silver golem planeswalker found vivisected and imprisoned at the root of Realmbreaker.
A silver golem whose dismembered body Tezzeret brought to Elesh Norn.
A silver golem whom Teferi thinks may have been found.
A metal heir created by Urza who shaped a plane.
A planeswalker taken by Norn after being lost.
A ravaged planeswalker brought before Norn, whose eyes still show signs of life.
A silver golem planeswalker, ravaged and lashed to slag by Norn's choir, who still feels pain and is rescued by his friends.
A silver golem planeswalker who gives up Venser's spark to help restore Nissa and Ajani.
A silver golem who builds himself a new body, walks out under his own power and kills Elesh Norn himself.
A silver golem who helps build the new village and fights the lightning beast.
A planeswalker included in the collection of artifacts called the Legacy.
A sentient silver golem and planeswalker with near-complete mastery over artifacts, created by Urza.
The silver golem built by Urza who created Mirrodin and unwittingly introduced Phyrexian oil to it.
The planeswalker who created Mirrodin, brought Phyrexian oil to it, lost his mind and became the Father of Machines and leader of Phyrexia until restored to sanity.
